description: This file defines a User class representing user data within a healthcare application. It includes properties such as id, email, fullName, and role. The class provides methods to instantiate from JSON, serialize to JSON, and create updated copies of User instances.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A domain model representing a user, aligned with backend auth/user data, with capabilities to serialize and deserialize JSON data and create copies with updated fields.

methods.name: User.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a User instance from a JSON map, handling potential key variations.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the User instance into a JSON map for serialization.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the User with specified fields replaced by new values.
